package.name: admm_fleet_msgs
package.description: Messages for the distributed ADMM-CBF-DMPC fleet layer (paper future work): AgentState / EdgeXi / EdgeZ carry the per-cycle ADMM consensus exchange over DDS, FleetPlan pushes slot goals and detours, CycleStats is the comms-measurement telemetry. Kept out of legged_msgs (submodule) to avoid coupling.
